name: PolyhedraGeom
description: Geometry of interaction between 2 Polyhedra, including volumetric characteristics

attributes.name: equivalentCrossSection
attributes.description: Cross-section area of the overlap (perpendicular to the normal) - not used

attributes.name: contactPoint
attributes.description: Contact point (global coords), centroid of the overlapping polyhedron

attributes.name: shearInc
attributes.description: Shear displacement increment in the last step

attributes.name: dispIndex
attributes.description: Return class index of this instance.

methods.name: dispHierarchy
methods.description: Return list of dispatch classes (from down upwards), starting with the class instance itself, top-level indexable at last. If names is true (default), return class names rather than numerical indices.

methods.name: updateAttrs
methods.description: Update object attributes from given dictionary
